before: Spec ref: Employee.Integral_Salary_Flag - CO-DIAN-001 (NIE056, Mandatory=Y), CO-PILA-003 v1.1 (T2R2-041, Mandatory=C; carried by Employee.PILA_Salary_Type, see the PILA Salary Type field). HARD RULE: where set, PILA T2R2-042 to T2R2-044 must be 70% of the integral salary plus any Ley 1393 de 2010 art. 30 excess (not reduced to 70%); T2R2-045 (CCF) is 70% of the integral salary and never takes the excess. An all-inclusive-salary employee accrues NO separate severance savings, service bonus or severance interest - see the Severance-Savings Regime field.

An all-inclusive-salary employee accrues NO separate severance savings, service bonus or severance interest - see the Severance-Savings Regime field.

before: Spec ref: Employee.Foreign_Not_Pension_Liable_Flag - CO-PILA-003 v1.1 (T2R2-007, Mandatory=C). Calculation-driving: where the option is set for the employee, the pension contribution is not reported (voluntary affiliation of foreigners under an employment contract not covered by a pension regime of their country of origin or any other: Ley 100 de 1993 art. 15 num. 2 (as modified by Ley 797 de 2003 art. 3)). Option per employee. Health, occupational risk and the payroll levies continue to apply.

before: Spec ref: Company.Cesantias_Fund_Code (declared in build_co_specs._DD_MASTER_MAPPINGS; the single-fund indicator is CO-CESANTIAS-006 E07, which back-references the per-employee field T02). OVERWRITE RULE: where E07 = Y this company-level value replaces the per-employee code for every record in the file; CO-CESANTIAS-006 v1.1 line 10 (E07 System Mapping) references this field (Company.Cesantias_Fund_Code). Using a single fund where employees are affiliated to different funds MISDIRECTS the deposit - the penalty is one day's salary per day of delay, per employee, uncapped.
